title: Next.js analyzer graph v1 record
description: Validates one typed JSON record per line of a versioned analyzer graph, not stream ordering, completion or cross-record joins. Extra fields can be additive in v1; missing, null or unknown evidence is not empty. Fields and record types vary with available producers. A valid record is build evidence, not observed browser requests or savings.

size.description: Byte attribution, not measured transfer or savings.

identity.description: Exact bundler module identity; different variants can share one source path, so join by identity rather than path.

type.description: Identifies this record as snapshot metadata.

schema_version.description: Version of each emitted record, not the private binary encoding.

snapshot_id.description: Generated snapshot-scoped capture ID, distinct from its optional UI name; not stable across rebuilds. New IDs include a collision-safe suffix; legacy captures may use timestamp/SHA-only IDs.

module_index_hash.description: Fingerprint of the ordered, snapshot-scoped modules.data indices, not proof of identical graphs or builds; null for legacy snapshots without an index fingerprint.

route_count.description: Number of all routes in this saved snapshot.

selected_routes.description: Number of route occurrences selected by the optional route filter.

meta.description: Snapshot metadata, expected first in a complete stream; the schema validates individual records, not stream ordering.

type.description: Identifies a module and its dependencies in the whole-app graph.

ident.description: Exact module identity used by dependency lists.

path.description: Source path; multiple module identities may share it, so paths are not safe module join keys.

dependencies.description: Importer-to-imported module identity lists. Sync and async imports differ from traced file relationships, which are not browser imports; the import graph may contain cycles.

module.description: Whole-app module graph, even when --route filters route-local records. Follow exact identities, not source paths.

module_ident.description: Exact identity of the nested client-reference module; join to the snapshot module graph by identity, not module_path.

module_path.description: Path associated with this nested client reference; join modules by exact identity instead.

reference_kind.description: Reference type such as ecmascript or css; this nested client reference is not an endpoint root or observed browser request.

route_entry_id.description: Snapshot-scoped endpoint root ID; multiple endpoint variants may share one route key. Preserve unknown roles and unmatched nested client references rather than guessing a browser root.

module_ident.description: Exact identity of this endpoint root module; multiple module variants can share one module_path.

module_path.description: Source path associated with this endpoint root; not a unique module identity.

role.description: Build-time role of the root; an app root may include nested client references and shared roots can appear on other endpoint artifacts. Not a browser-load classification.

runtime.description: Endpoint runtime when known; null means unavailable.

entry_kind.description: Server or client-bootstrap classification when known; null or another classification means do not infer client initial-load scope.

client_references.description: Client references nested under an endpoint root, not another root or proof of an initial browser request. Join only by the exact module identity.

type.description: Identifies a route occurrence and its available build-time evidence.

route.description: Route key from this snapshot's routes.json.

route_index.description: Occurrence of this route in routes.json; repeated route keys have distinct indices.

entries.description: Route endpoint roots, including possible shared pages roots on an API artifact; their presence alone does not mean the browser loads them for that API. Null means legacy or unavailable evidence.
The producer supplied typed endpoint roots for this route when exact. This is not a statement about browser requests or timing.

coverage.description: Completeness of separate build-time route evidence; unknown is not empty.

route.description: One snapshot route occurrence; repeated route keys remain distinct through route_index. Route-local records join by both keys.

type.description: Identifies an emitted output file for a route occurrence.

filename.description: Emitted output path scoped to this saved snapshot, not stable across rebuilds or proof of a browser request. Verify the chosen artifact's [client-fs]/ client-output convention; server outputs and traced files are not automatically browser work.

modules.description: Joined module identities from this snapshot's global module table when enumerable. Null means unavailable data, not an empty output; separately compiled worker payloads can remain unjoined.

coverage.description: Membership evidence: exact joins all enumerable JS/CSS chunk members; unsupported could not establish complete enumeration or joining (partial members may exist); not_a_chunk is outside JS/CSS chunk membership; unknown is missing evidence. Unsupported and unknown never mean an empty chunk.

output.description: An emitted file for a route occurrence, not an observed browser request. Output membership and source-part size attribution are separate; check which files are actually client outputs before treating them as browser work.

type.description: Identifies source-size attribution within an emitted output file.

filename.description: Output file to which this source part is attributed.

source_path.description: Reconstructed source path, not a unique module identity.

size.description: Attributed uncompressed bytes, not predicted savings.

compressed_size.description: Attributed compressed bytes, not observed network transfer.

part.description: Source attribution within an emitted output. Count each selected part once; directory and descendant totals can overlap. Attribution weights predict neither savings nor transfer bytes and are separate from exact module membership.

type.description: Identifies an output member that could not join the global snapshot module table.

route_index.description: Index of the owning route occurrence in this snapshot's routes.json; join route-local records by both route and route_index.

filename.description: Emitted output filename containing the unjoined module, scoped by route and route_index.

module_ident.description: Exact module identity reported for this output but not joined to the snapshot's global module table; separately compiled worker payloads can be unjoined.

reason.description: Reason a reported output member cannot join the global snapshot module table.
